idea.title: WebLLM: high-performance in-browser LLM inference engine

plan.tagline: Run LLMs locally in your browser with pure Python CLI
plan.problem: Developers waste time configuring complex LLM inference stacks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) just to test models offline
plan.solution: Provides a zero-config CLI that serves LLMs directly in-browser via WebAssembly, using only Python standard library for portability
plan.target_market: Indie hackers and small dev teams needing lightweight LLM inference without heavy dependencies

build_phases.name: Core Engine
build_phases.description: WASM loader + model registry with add/list commands

build_phases.name: Inference Loop
build_phases.description: Prompt processing + token streaming to browser

build_phases.name: Demo + Packaging
build_phases.description: Hardcoded demo model + PyPI packaging + docs

plan.demo_script: Run `llmcli --demo` to load a 3B parameter model, type 'What is Python?' and get a streaming response in your terminal via WebSocket
plan.phuket_angle: Thai tourism SMEs could use it to run offline chatbots for guest queries without cloud costs
